metadata.name: moon_forge
metadata.description: Moon Forge Protocol v2 - burn XEN on any EVM chain, earn XNT on X1. Zero protocol fees on the burn path.

accounts.name: player_state
docs: Game wallet of the entry's player: receives the refund when the round was refunded.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone can top up anyone's game balance.

instructions.name: donate
docs: target: 0 = reward pool (burners), 1 = bankroll (games), 2 = Burn Lottery prize

accounts.name: first_player_state
docs: Game wallet of the first player (refund path when nobody else joined).

instructions.name: forge_artifact
docs: max_price: the buyer never pays more than this (the dynamic price may have moved).

accounts.name: signer
docs: Owner or session key. Pays the (refundable) bet account rent.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Only the owner can withdraw. Session keys never can.

errors.name: OnlyOracle
errors.msg: Only the oracle can do this

errors.name: NotPendingOracle
errors.msg: Only the pending oracle can accept

errors.name: OnlyArchitect
errors.msg: Only the architect can do this

errors.name: EpochTooSoon
errors.msg: Too early: minimum interval between epochs not reached

errors.name: PoolEmpty
errors.msg: Reward pool has no free balance

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is neither the owner nor an active session key

errors.name: NotReady
errors.msg: Randomness not available yet, retry in a moment

errors.name: NotWinningEntry
errors.msg: This entry does not hold the winning ticket

errors.name: DuelState
errors.msg: Duel is not in the expected state

errors.name: InvalidArtifact
errors.msg: Not a valid Moon Forge artifact

errors.name: NotArtifactOwner
errors.msg: You do not own this artifact

errors.name: ChipsAlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: Chips already claimed for this artifact this week

errors.name: DropNotPending
errors.msg: Forge Drop seed is not pending

errors.name: DropNotSealed
errors.msg: Forge Drop seed not sealed yet

errors.name: NoDrop
errors.msg: This leaf did not win a Forge Drop

errors.name: NotSoldOut
errors.msg: Lunar Dust is not sold out: claim the Artifact itself

errors.name: DropCapReached
errors.msg: This epoch's Forge Drops are exhausted

errors.name: DailyLossLimit
errors.msg: The bankroll lost 10% today: house games resume tomorrow

errors.name: OwnerOnly
errors.msg: Only the wallet owner can enter player-vs-player games

types.name: AirdropReceipt
docs: Seeds: ["airdrop", claimant]

types.name: ArtifactRecord
docs: Moon Forge side-car for each Core asset. Holds the artifact's floor (backing) in lamports.
Seeds: ["artifact", asset]

types.name: Bet
docs: A pending house bet. Seeds: ["bet", player_state, nonce_le]

types.name: ClaimReceipt
docs: Anti double-claim. Seeds: ["receipt", epoch_le, player, tier]. Closable only after
the epoch is closed (claims are impossible then), refunding rent to whoever paid it.

types.name: Config
docs: Global protocol state. Created once by the permissionless `initialize_v2`
with values taken from compile-time constants (nothing can be front-run).

fields.name: pending_oracle
docs: Two-step oracle hand-over. Pubkey::default() = none pending.

fields.name: bumps
docs: bumps of [reward_vault, bankroll_vault, draw_vault, collection, artifact_authority]

fields.name: reward_reserved
docs: Sum over open epochs of (budget - claimed). Not part of the free pool.

fields.name: bankroll_reserved
docs: Sum of the gross payouts of all unsettled house bets.

fields.name: house_protocol_shares
docs: Shares minted to the protocol for value that existed before the first LP.
They are never withdrawable: a permanent bankroll floor.

fields.name: artifact_price
docs: Dynamic forge price per tier after the last forge (0 = never forged: base price).

fields.name: artifact_price_ts
docs: Time of the last forge per tier (start of the weekly decay).

fields.name: bankroll_day
docs: Circuit breaker: current day and the bankroll value at its start (adjusted by LP flows).

types.name: DrawEntry
docs: Seeds: ["draw_entry", round_le, index_le]

types.name: DrawRound
docs: Weekly Burn Lottery. Seeds: ["draw", round_le]

types.name: DropReceipt
docs: Anti double-drop. Seeds: ["drop", epoch_le, player, tier]

fields.name: asset
docs: Pubkey::default() when the drop was paid in XNT (Lunar Dust sold out)

fields.name: cancelled
docs: true = nobody sealed within the SlotHashes window: the reserve went back to the pool

fields.name: asset
docs: Pubkey::default() when paid in XNT because Lunar Dust was sold out

types.name: Duel
docs: Artifact Duel (commit-reveal PvP). Holds both stakes. Seeds: ["duel", creator, nonce_le]

types.name: Epoch
docs: One per published epoch. Seeds: ["epoch", epoch_id_le]

fields.name: data_hash
docs: sha256 of the full epoch JSON published by the oracle (every burn, every score).

fields.name: rate_cap
docs: Max lamports paid per score unit (mandatory, > 0). It can only LOWER the budget:
budget = min(10% of free pool, total_score * rate_cap). Prevents mint-and-burn farming
windfalls; whatever is not distributed simply stays in the pool.

fields.name: budget
docs: Paid pro-rata to the leaves (the epoch budget minus `drop_reserve`).

fields.name: drop_reserve
docs: Forge Drops: share of the epoch budget paid as random Lunar Dust (see constants.rs).

fields.name: drop_paid
docs: Floors given to drop winners (can exceed the reserve by luck; the excess comes from the free pool).

fields.name: drop_state
docs: DROP_NONE / DROP_PENDING / DROP_SEALED / DROP_CANCELLED

types.name: HouseShare
docs: Bankroll LP position. Seeds: ["house", owner]

types.name: JackpotEntry
docs: Seeds: ["jp_entry", round_le, index_le]

types.name: JackpotRound
docs: Multiplayer pot. Holds the pot lamports. Seeds: ["jackpot", round_le]

types.name: Mission
docs: Vesting position for Orbit / Moon Landing. Holds its own XNT.
Seeds: ["mission", epoch_le, player, tier]

types.name: PlayerState
docs: Game wallet of a player. Lamports held = rent + `balance`.
Seeds: ["player", owner]

fields.name: chips
docs: Non-transferable Burn Lottery chips.

fields.name: session_key
docs: Optional delegated key (bots / auto-play). Can bet, can never withdraw.

fields.name: expired_draws_to_pool
docs: Lottery prizes of weeks nobody settled in time, sent to the reward pool.
